os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
out = img.resize((W, H), Image.LANCZOS)
out.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", optimize=True)
print(f"Saved /app/output/final_poster.png  {W}x{H}  (y_end={y})")

"""
Coding AI Leaderboard social-media poster generator — v2.
Portrait 1080×1920, dark mode, GitHub × Bloomberg terminal aesthetic.
Output: /app/output/final_poster.png
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

# ── Canvas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H    = 1080, 1920
SCALE   = 2
RW, RH  = W * SCALE, H * SCALE

# ── Palette ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG          = (15, 17, 25)
PANEL       = (24, 27, 40)
PANEL_ALT   = (20, 23, 34)
BORDER      = (38, 42, 62)
BLUE        = (56,  139, 253)
GREEN       = (52,  211, 153)
AMBER       = (251, 191,  36)
ORANGE      = (249,  115,  22)
PURPLE      = (167,  139, 250)
TEAL        = ( 45,  212, 191)
PINK        = (244,  114, 182)
WHITE       = (226,  232, 255)
MUTED       = (100,  116, 155)
DARK_LABEL  = ( 28,   32,  48)

UP_CLR   = (52,  211, 153)
DOWN_CLR = (248,  113, 113)
SAME_CLR = (100,  116, 155)
NEW_CLR  = ( 56,  139, 253)

TAG_CONFIG = {
    "agent":    (( 23,  37,  84), BLUE,   "AGENT"),
    "claude":   (( 46,  16,  87), PURPLE, "CLAUDE"),
    "utility":  (( 19,  55,  54), TEAL,   "UTILITY"),
    "design":   (( 80,  22,  68), PINK,   "DESIGN"),
    "resource": (( 68,  48,  10), AMBER,  "RESOURCE"),
}

# ── Font helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_BOLD   = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/open-sans/OpenSans-Bold.ttf"
FONT_XBOLD  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/open-sans/OpenSans-ExtraBold.ttf"
FONT_SEMI   = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/open-sans/OpenSans-Semibold.ttf"
FONT_REG    = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/open-sans/OpenSans-Light.ttf"
FONT_MONO   = "/usr/share/fonts/fonts-go/Go-Mono-Bold.ttf"
FONT_MONO_R = "/usr/share/fonts/fonts-go/Go-Mono.ttf"

_font_cache = {}
def fnt(path, size):
    key = (path, size)
    if key not in _font_cache:
        _font_cache[key] = ImageFont.truetype(path, size * SCALE)
    return _font_cache[key]

def s(v):   return int(v * SCALE)
def ss(v):  return int(v * SCALE * SCALE)   # already-scaled passthrough

# ── Draw helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def fill(draw, x, y, w, h, color, r=0):
    if r:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([s(x), s(y), s(x+w), s(y+h)], radius=s(r), fill=color)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([s(x), s(y), s(x+w), s(y+h)], fill=color)

def outline_rect(draw, x, y, w, h, color, r=0, lw=2):
    if r:
        draw.rounded_rectangle([s(x), s(y), s(x+w), s(y+h)], radius=s(r),
                                outline=color, width=lw * SCALE)
    else:
        draw.rectangle([s(x), s(y), s(x+w), s(y+h)], outline=color, width=lw * SCALE)

def tw(draw, text, f):
    return draw.textlength(text, font=f) / SCALE

def put(draw, text, x, y, f, color, anchor="lt"):
    draw.text((s(x), s(y)), text, font=f, fill=color, anchor=anchor)

def cput(draw, text, cx, y, f, color):
    w_ = tw(draw, text, f)
    draw.text((s(cx - w_/2), s(y)), text, font=f, fill=color)

def rput(draw, text, rx, y, f, color):
    w_ = tw(draw, text, f)
    draw.text((s(rx - w_), s(y)), text, font=f, fill=color)

def pill(draw, x, y, label, bg_color, fg_color, f, px=7, py=3):
    tw_ = tw(draw, label, f)
    box_w = tw_ + px * 2
    box_h = 16
    fill(draw, x, y, box_w, box_h, bg_color, r=4)
    put(draw, label, x + px, y + py, f, fg_color)
    return box_w  # logical width

def bar_h_draw(draw, x, y, w_max, h, frac, bg, fg, r=2):
    fill(draw, x, y, w_max, h, bg, r=r)
    bar_w = max(4, int(w_max * frac))
    fill(draw, x, y, bar_w, h, fg, r=r)

def trunc(draw, text, f, max_w):
    if tw(draw, text, f) <= max_w:
        return text
    while len(text) > 3 and tw(draw, text + "…", f) > max_w:
        text = text[:-1]
    return text + "…"

# ── Data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
RANKINGS = [
    (1,  "—",  "NousResearch/hermes-agent",              9715,  "agent"),
    (2,  "▲",  "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills",    4917,  "resource"),
    (3,  "—",  "JuliusBrussee/caveman",                  4407,  "agent"),
    (4,  "▼",  "MemPalace/mempalace",                    3524,  "utility"),
    (5,  "—",  "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",            3246,  "design"),
    (6,  "▲",  "microsoft/markitdown",                   3048,  "utility"),
    (7,  "▼",  "safishamsi/graphify",                    2763,  "design"),
    (8,  "▲",  "obra/superpowers",                       2180,  "agent"),
    (9,  "▲",  "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", 2151,  "claude"),
    (10, "—",  "affaan-m/everything-claude-code",        1978,  "claude"),
    (11, "▲",  "thedotmack/claude-mem",                  1828,  "claude"),
    (12, "▼",  "santifer/career-ops",                    1788,  "utility"),
    (13, "▲",  "multica-ai/multica",                     1506,  "agent"),
    (14, "▲",  "shiyu-coder/Kronos",                     1286,  "utility"),
    (15, "▼",  "ultraworkers/claw-code",                 1285,  "claude"),
    (16, "▼",  "openclaw/openclaw",                      1268,  "claude"),
    (17, "▼",  "OpenBMB/VoxCPM",                         1266,  "agent"),
    (18, "▼",  "addyosmani/agent-skills",                1195,  "agent"),
    (19, "—",  "rtk-ai/rtk",                             1098,  "utility"),
    (20, "N",  "garrytan/gstack",                        1012,  "utility"),
]

MAX_STARS = RANKINGS[0][3]

TREND_MAP = {"▲": UP_CLR, "▼": DOWN_CLR, "—": SAME_CLR, "N": NEW_CLR}

TAKEAWAYS = [
    (ORANGE, "🚀  Agent-first dev surging — hermes-agent +9,715 ⭐"),
    (PURPLE, "🤖  Claude Code ecosystem: 5 repos, 8,500+ stars"),
    (TEAL,   "🔧  Utility infra (markitdown, graphify) growing steady"),
]

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# LAYOUT — measure everything first, then draw top-to-bottom
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
PAD   = 14   # horizontal margin
INNER = W - PAD * 2

# Fixed heights
HEADER_H   = 118
METRICS_H  = 78
SEP_H      = 20     # section label bars
HERO_H     = 72
MINI_H     = 52
TABLE_ROW  = 44
LEGEND_H   = 28
KT_ROW_H   = 40
FOOTER_H   = 48

# Gaps
G1 = 10   # between major sections
G2 = 6    # between sub-elements

TABLE_ROWS_N = len(RANKINGS)
KT_ROWS_N    = len(TAKEAWAYS)

total_h = (HEADER_H + G1 +
           METRICS_H + G1 +
           SEP_H + HERO_H + G2 + MINI_H + G1 +
           SEP_H + TABLE_ROWS_N * TABLE_ROW + G1 +
           LEGEND_H + G1 +
           SEP_H + KT_ROWS_N * KT_ROW_H + G2 +
           FOOTER_H)

# If content fits in 1920, fine. Otherwise, scale.
# (We'll just trust our numbers fit — table is 20*44=880, total ≈ 1880)

# ── Create canvas ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img  = Image.new("RGB", (RW, RH), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

y = 0  # running cursor (logical pixels)

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# HEADER
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fill(draw, 0, y, W, HEADER_H, (18, 21, 33))

# Top accent bar
fill(draw, 0, y, W, 4, BLUE)

cput(draw, "⭐  GITHUB STAR LEADERBOARD",
     W/2, y + 12, fnt(FONT_XBOLD, 15), BLUE)
cput(draw, "TOP 20 CODING AI REPOS  •  APR 9–15, 2026",
     W/2, y + 33, fnt(FONT_SEMI, 10), MUTED)

# Main title
cput(draw, "CODING AI", W/2, y + 50, fnt(FONT_XBOLD, 32), WHITE)
cput(draw, "WEEKLY LEADERBOARD", W/2, y + 88, fnt(FONT_BOLD, 13), MUTED)

y += HEADER_H + G1

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# METRIC CARDS (4 wide)
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CARD_W = (INNER - G2 * 3) / 4

METRICS = [
    ("+9,715", "Top weekly gain",    ORANGE),
    ("~48k",   "Total new stars",    GREEN),
    ("5",      "Claude repos",       PURPLE),
    ("10",     "Repos 2k+ stars",    AMBER),
]

for i, (val, lbl, clr) in enumerate(METRICS):
    cx = PAD + i * (CARD_W + G2)
    fill(draw, cx, y, CARD_W, METRICS_H, PANEL, r=8)
    fill(draw, cx, y, 4, METRICS_H, clr)  # left stripe
    cput(draw, val,  cx + CARD_W/2, y + 10, fnt(FONT_MONO, 20), clr)
    cput(draw, lbl,  cx + CARD_W/2, y + 55, fnt(FONT_SEMI,  9), MUTED)

y += METRICS_H + G1

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# TOP 5 SECTION
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fill(draw, 0, y, W, SEP_H, (18, 21, 33))
cput(draw, "TOP 5 THIS WEEK", W/2, y + 4, fnt(FONT_SEMI, 10), MUTED)
y += SEP_H

# Hero card (#1 hermes-agent)
fill(draw, PAD, y, INNER, HERO_H, (30, 20, 12), r=10)
outline_rect(draw, PAD, y, INNER, HERO_H, ORANGE, r=10, lw=2)

put(draw, "#1",  PAD + 14, y + 8,  fnt(FONT_MONO, 30), ORANGE)
put(draw, "NousResearch/", PAD + 80, y + 10, fnt(FONT_SEMI, 10), MUTED)
put(draw, "hermes-agent", PAD + 80, y + 28,  fnt(FONT_XBOLD, 20), WHITE)

rput(draw, "+9,715 ⭐", W - PAD - 2, y + 22, fnt(FONT_MONO, 20), ORANGE)

# Progress bar
bx = PAD + 80
bw = INNER - 80 - 80
bar_h_draw(draw, bx, y + 58, bw, 6, 1.0, (50, 38, 20), ORANGE, r=3)

y += HERO_H + G2

# Mini top 2–5
MINI_W = (INNER - G2 * 3) / 4
for i, (rank, trend, repo, stars, tag) in enumerate(RANKINGS[1:5]):
    mx = PAD + i * (MINI_W + G2)
    fill(draw, mx, y, MINI_W, MINI_H, PANEL, r=7)

    # rank
    put(draw, f"#{rank}", mx + 8, y + 4, fnt(FONT_MONO, 12), AMBER)

    # name (short = just the repo part)
    name = repo.split("/")[-1]
    name = trunc(draw, name, fnt(FONT_BOLD, 9), MINI_W - 16)
    put(draw, name, mx + 8, y + 20, fnt(FONT_BOLD, 9), WHITE)

    rput(draw, f"+{stars:,}", mx + MINI_W - 6, y + 5,
         fnt(FONT_MONO, 10), GREEN)

    frac = stars / MAX_STARS
    bar_h_draw(draw, mx + 8, y + 40, MINI_W - 16, 5, frac, PANEL_ALT, GREEN, r=2)

y += MINI_H + G1

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FULL TOP-20 TABLE
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fill(draw, 0, y, W, SEP_H, (18, 21, 33))
cput(draw, "FULL TOP 20 RANKING", W/2, y + 4, fnt(FONT_SEMI, 10), MUTED)
y += SEP_H

# Column x-positions (logical)
# [rank 3ch] [trend 2ch] [name flexible] [bar 120px] [stars 70px]
C_RANK  = PAD            # left edge of rank number
C_TREND = PAD + 34       # trend symbol
C_NAME  = PAD + 56       # repo name starts
C_BAR_R = W - PAD - 72  # right edge of bar
C_BAR_L = C_BAR_R - 118 # left edge of bar  (bar = 118px wide)
C_STAR  = W - PAD        # right edge of star count

NAME_MAX_W = C_BAR_L - C_NAME - 6   # max name width in logical px

RANK_F   = fnt(FONT_MONO,   11)
TREND_F  = fnt(FONT_BOLD,   11)
ORG_F    = fnt(FONT_MONO_R,  9)
NAME_F   = fnt(FONT_MONO,    9)
STARS_F  = fnt(FONT_MONO,   10)
TAG_F    = fnt(FONT_SEMI,    7)

for i, (rank, trend, repo, stars, tag) in enumerate(RANKINGS):
    row_y   = y + i * TABLE_ROW
    bg_clr  = PANEL if i % 2 == 0 else PANEL_ALT
    fill(draw, 0, row_y, W, TABLE_ROW, bg_clr)
    # divider
    draw.line([s(0), s(row_y), s(W), s(row_y)], fill=BORDER, width=SCALE)

    # rank
    rk_clr = ORANGE if rank == 1 else (AMBER if rank <= 3 else MUTED)
    put(draw, f"{rank:2d}", C_RANK, row_y + 12, RANK_F, rk_clr)

    # trend
    t_clr = TREND_MAP.get(trend, SAME_CLR)
    put(draw, trend, C_TREND, row_y + 12, TREND_F, t_clr)

    # org + repo name  — org on top in muted, repo name in white below
    org, name = repo.split("/", 1) if "/" in repo else ("", repo)
    org_s  = org + "/"
    org_tw = tw(draw, org_s, ORG_F)

    # check combined width; if too wide, drop org prefix
    name_tw_ = tw(draw, name, NAME_F)
    if org_tw + name_tw_ <= NAME_MAX_W:
        put(draw, org_s, C_NAME, row_y + 5,  ORG_F,  MUTED)
        put(draw, name,  C_NAME + org_tw, row_y + 5, NAME_F, WHITE)
    else:
        name_t = trunc(draw, name, NAME_F, NAME_MAX_W)
        put(draw, name_t, C_NAME, row_y + 5, NAME_F, WHITE)

    # category pill
    if tag in TAG_CONFIG:
        tb, tc, tl = TAG_CONFIG[tag]
        pill(draw, C_NAME, row_y + 23, tl, tb, tc, TAG_F)

    # mini bar
    frac = stars / MAX_STARS
    bar_clr = ORANGE if rank == 1 else (GREEN if rank <= 5 else BLUE)
    bar_h_draw(draw, C_BAR_L, row_y + (TABLE_ROW - 6)//2 + 4,
               118, 6, frac, (30, 34, 52), bar_clr, r=2)

    # star count — green if ≥ 2000
    s_clr = GREEN if stars >= 2000 else WHITE
    rput(draw, f"+{stars:,}", C_STAR, row_y + 12, STARS_F, s_clr)

TABLE_END = y + TABLE_ROWS_N * TABLE_ROW
y = TABLE_END + G1

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# LEGEND
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    ("AGENT",    (23, 37,  84), BLUE),
    ("CLAUDE",   (46, 16,  87), PURPLE),
    ("UTILITY",  (19, 55,  54), TEAL),
    ("DESIGN",   (80, 22,  68), PINK),
    ("RESOURCE", (68, 48,  10), AMBER),
]

px = (W - total_pw) / 2
py = y + 6
for lbl, tb, tc in PILLS:
    pw_ = pill(draw, px, py, lbl, tb, tc, pl_fnt, px=7, py=3)
    px += pw_ + gap_p

y += LEGEND_H + G1

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# KEY TAKEAWAYS
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fill(draw, 0, y, W, SEP_H, (18, 21, 33))
cput(draw, "KEY TAKEAWAYS", W/2, y + 4, fnt(FONT_SEMI, 10), MUTED)
y += SEP_H

for i, (clr, txt) in enumerate(TAKEAWAYS):
    ky = y + i * (KT_ROW_H + G2)
    fill(draw, PAD, ky, INNER, KT_ROW_H, PANEL, r=7)
    fill(draw, PAD, ky, 4, KT_ROW_H, clr)
    put(draw, txt, PAD + 16, ky + (KT_ROW_H - 14)//2, KT_F, WHITE)

y += KT_ROWS_N * (KT_ROW_H + G2) + G2

# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# FOOTER  (fill to bottom)
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fill(draw, 0, y, W, H - y, (12, 14, 22))
cput(draw, "Data: star-history.com  •  Week of April 9–15, 2026",
     W/2, y + 8,  fnt(FONT_SEMI, 9), MUTED)
